messages:
alex: Candidate created for v2024.03.1 — artifact pinned to sha abcd1234. Planning promotion to prod in ~60m within change window 15:00-16:00 UTC. Release notes draft: https://go/release-notes/draft. Please ack smoke + DB migration readiness. @maria @ryan @priya

deploy-bot: [deploybot] Candidate pinned: service-feed@abcd1234. Canary started in us-west1 (10% traffic).

maria: smoke passed on staging (kv warm and basic flows) :thumbsup: logs look clean.

ryan: canary traffic running. saw embed-service 5xx spike at 15:02, investigating — temporarily rolling back that canary instance.

ryan: update — toggled embed model weight back, 5xx dropped to baseline. still monitoring :eyes: 

priya: DB migration check: migration v3 is backwards compatible, feature flag defaults OFF. ops approved scheduled migration at t+30m :white_check_mark: 

jen: release notes: please add a short note about embeddings config change and new quantization param (affects low-latency builds).

alex: Decision: keep promotion window but use conservative ramp: 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100% with 10min holds. Rollback target = previous prod sha aa9900ff if regressions > 3% error rate or latency p95 increases by >100ms. Any objections?

maria: no objections.

priya: ack.

ops-oncall: I'll set alerts for embed-service error_rate and kv cache misses. Will trigger rollback if thresholds breach.

alex: Final ask — update changelog and tag repo: tag v2024.03.1-abcd1234. I'll kick the promo at 15:15 UTC unless someone vetoes in the next 5m.

ryan: veto — prefer one more canary sweep in 10m to be safe. can wait.

alex: OK moving to 15:25. Deploybot: keep canary warm and hold for 10m after sweep.

deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Canary hold set for 10m.

alex: Once we start, I'll be watching these dashboards: services.overview/latency, infra.kv/misses, errors/embed-service. If rollback is needed run: 

alex: ```bash
# rollback (ops-run)
deployctl promote --to-prod --artifact sha=aa9900ff --reason "rollback-triggered"
```

ops-oncall: copied rollback cmd and ready to execute. Standby.

alex: OK starting promotion now (15:25 UTC). :rocket:

deploy-bot: Promotion initiated. Ramp plan: 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100%, 10m holds at each step. Watching telemetry.

maria: seeing traffic shift on dashboards.

priya: migration started (online, non-blocking) — monitoring DB replicas.

ryan: all green so far, p95 within expected bounds. :thumbsup:

ops-oncall: no alerts fired.

alex: Promotion complete. Prod tagged v2024.03.1 (sha abcd1234). Opening post-release smoke window for 30m. Thanks team.

maria: nice work everyone :tada:
